header.description: Figure 6b of Prakash et al. 2025 (arXiv:2505.14685): swap each character and container mention for the residual stream of the same word in the counterfactual at every layer from 0 to L, with the drink tokens frozen at their original values at every layer (`frozen`), only at layers L to 79 (`late`, the order the authors' script applies its writes in) or left free (`unfrozen`, the Figure 13 control), and score all three against label_source_forms; workflows/scripts/lookbacks/lookbacks_figure.py draws the curves, over every pair and over the pairs lookbacks_clean_accuracy.json marks correct.
